root_cause.arithmetic: Regular CommonData computes the row from (_data.get() - record)/RecordSize, reversing the forward record offset. For external-ID row1 this narrows-1 to UINT32_MAX, then RecordGetId indexes _idTable out of bounds. In-record IDs ignore the passed row and can mask the error. Row0 also masks it. The common-value lookup needs the actual record's external ID to select its override/default; do not clamp to row0, substitute a default, disable assertions or skip the table.
root_cause.repair: One production expression changes to (record - _data.get())/RecordSize. Keep actual RecordGetId, common override lookup, defaults, types, record-size division, ordinary/sparse/other-compression branches and diagnostics unchanged. No broad malformed-file validation or64-bit common-value semantics repair is claimed.
